title: A query log row that names an internal root is delivered only as the operator's answer says
goal: The query log's delivery reads the qualified paths a row already holds and, for a row naming an internal root, does what gate g-ql answers; no recorded field is added or removed

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import ql_deliver; assert hasattr(ql_deliver, 'internal_root_rows'), 'no internal_root_rows in ql_deliver'

gates.question: Is a query log row whose pack or paths name an internal root delivered to the shared store?
options: kept in the local spool and never delivered to the shared store
delivered to the shared store as today
delivered to the internal root's own repository
gates.recommendation: kept in the local spool and never delivered to the shared store

notes: Draft, outside any sprint: what the query log delivers is the operator's call (query-log recording), so gate g-ql stays open for the operator. The rows already hold qualified paths (<root>/<path>), so no new field is needed. The check is a placeholder to replace when the item is planned into a sprint: a planted spool with one row naming an internal root and one naming public, run through the delivery's dry run. Design: kb/_self/design.md, Teams and organizations.
